+def _jobs(data):
+    jobs = data["jobs"]
+    k = data["k"]
+    blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+    options = [job for job in jobs if job["id"] not in blocked]
+    best_value = None
+    best_ids = None
+
+    for subset in combinations(options, k):
+        ids = {job["id"] for job in subset}
+        if not mandatory.issubset(ids):
+            continue
+        counts = {}
+        for job in subset:
+            counts[job["group"]] = counts.get(job["group"], 0) + 1
+        if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+               for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+            continue
+        ordered = sorted(subset, key=lambda job: (job["start"], job["end"]))
+        if any(ordered[i - 1]["end"] > ordered[i]["start"]
+               for i in range(1, len(ordered))):
+            continue
+        value = sum(job["value"] for job in subset)
+        selected_ids = sorted(ids)
+        if (best_value is None or value > best_value or
+                (value == best_value and selected_ids < best_ids)):
+            best_value, best_ids = value, selected_ids
+
+    if best_value is None:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    return {"selected": best_ids, "value": best_value}
+

+def _routes(data):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    bits = {node: 1 << i for i, node in enumerate(required)}
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+
+    source = data["source"]
+    initial_mask = bits.get(source, 0)
+    coupons = data["coupons"]
+    initial_state = (source, initial_mask, coupons)
+    distances = {initial_state: data["start"]}
+    queue = [(data["start"], source, initial_mask, coupons)]
+
+    while queue:
+        time, node, mask, left = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, left)
+        if distances.get(state) != time:
+            continue
+        if node == data["target"] and mask == full and left == 0:
+            return {"arrival": time}
+
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(time, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            options = [(edge["duration"], left)]
+            if left:
+                duration = max(2, edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0))
+                options.append((duration, left - 1))
+            next_mask = mask | bits.get(edge["v"], 0)
+            for duration, next_left in options:
+                arrival = depart + duration
+                if arrival > data["deadline"]:
+                    continue
+                next_state = (edge["v"], next_mask, next_left)
+                if arrival < distances.get(next_state, float("inf")):
+                    distances[next_state] = arrival
+                    heapq.heappush(queue, (arrival, edge["v"], next_mask, next_left))
+    return {"arrival": None}
